title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Standardizing Enforcement Work
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Regulating Enforcement Work"

Fa Fa [2009] No. 43

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Supreme People's Court's "Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Regulating Enforcement Work" are hereby issued to you. Please implement them earnestly in light of actual work circumstances.

July 17, 2009

Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Regulating Enforcement Work

In recent years, under the leadership of Party committees at all levels, the supervision of People's Congresses, and the support of governments, the People's Courts have continuously advanced reforms of the enforcement system and mechanisms, improved the long-term mechanism for enforcement work, and organized campaigns to centrally clear backlogged enforcement cases. This has effectively safeguarded the legitimate rights and interests of the people, upheld social fairness and justice, and promoted social harmony and stability. However, the difficulty in enforcement has not been fundamentally resolved; the level of standardization in enforcement work still needs further improvement; and the intensity and timeliness of enforcement need to be strengthened. To this end, People's Courts at all levels must further implement the Scientific Outlook on Development and a series of central government documents, focus on resolving the difficulty in enforcement, effectively improve and perfect the enforcement work system and mechanism, strive to advance the construction of a long-term mechanism for enforcement work, and comprehensively enhance the level of standardization in enforcement work.

I. Further Intensifying Enforcement Efforts

(1) Establish a rapid response mechanism for enforcement. Efforts shall be made to enhance the rapid response capability in enforcement work, strengthen communication with public security, procuratorial, and other departments, and promptly handle enforcement leads and emergencies. Higher and Intermediate People's Courts shall establish enforcement command centers and assemble rapid response forces. Qualified Basic People's Courts may also establish enforcement command centers based on work needs. The head of the command center shall be the President or an authorized Vice President, with the Head of the Enforcement Bureau specifically responsible for organizing implementation. To facilitate coordination with disciplinary inspection, public security, procuratorial, and other relevant departments, and to uniformly deploy various types of judicial resources, a qualified Head of the Enforcement Bureau may be appointed as a member of the Leading Party Group. The command center's working body shall be located in the Enforcement Bureau, and a 24-hour duty phone line shall be opened. Rapid response forces shall be composed of enforcement personnel and judicial police from courts within the jurisdiction, with sub-groups set up to swiftly take enforcement actions according to the command center's instructions.

(2) Improve the coordination and cooperation mechanism among filing, trial, and enforcement. Strengthen collaboration and cooperation among the three stages of filing, trial, and enforcement to form a combined force within the court to resolve the difficulty in enforcement. During the filing stage, litigation guidance, legal interpretation, risk disclosure, and pre-trial conciliation shall be strengthened, particularly by timely adopting pre-litigation property preservation measures for cases meeting statutory conditions. During the trial stage, for qualified cases, timely measures for litigation preservation and advance execution shall be taken according to law; litigation mediation shall be vigorously promoted to increase the rate of immediate performance and voluntary performance in mediated cases; the reasoning in judgments shall be enhanced, and the system of post-judgment答疑 (answering questions) shall be strengthened to encourage parties to accept judgments and settle disputes, concluding cases and resolving matters; efforts shall be made to improve the quality of judgment documents, enhance reasoning, accurately and clearly state the rights and obligations of both parties, and fully consider the enforceability of the judgment items.

(3) Establish an effective mechanism for handling enforcement-related petitions and letters. People's Courts at all levels shall set up specialized bodies for handling enforcement complaints, responsible for reviewing and supervising enforcement-related complaints and petitions. On the basis of clarifying functional divisions with departments such as the Filing Division, a four-tier court, vertically integrated enforcement complaint review and handling mechanism shall be explored and established. Higher courts shall establish a system of listed supervision over enforcement complaint cases within their jurisdiction, set up dedicated pages on the People's Court website, register cases one by one, strengthen supervision, and cancel the registration after classification and closure. Further standardize the processing flow of enforcement complaint cases, ensure smooth channels for public opinion communication, and implement public hearings for all major and complex complaint cases. Attention shall be paid to initial complaints and first-time petitions, starting from the grassroots and the source. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with relevant departments, and fully leverage the role of the petition-termination mechanism under the leadership of Party committees. Increase the intensity of supervision over petition cases, implement the system of leadership responsibility for specific cases, and carry out ranking and notification of enforcement petition situations. Improve the evaluation mechanism for enforcement petition work, as well as mechanisms for accountability for petitions and reverse investigation of responsibility.

(4) Intensify enforcement publicity work. People's Courts at all levels shall strengthen contact with Party committee publicity departments, regard enforcement work as an important part of legal publicity work, formulate an overall plan for enforcement publicity, and enhance the legal awareness and risk awareness of the whole society. Establish stable cooperative relationships with media such as radio, newspapers, television, and the internet, and adopt methods such as holding press conferences, special reports, follow-up reports, on-site interviews, and setting up columns to carry out publicity activities including explaining enforcement laws and policies, reporting major enforcement activities, publicizing typical cases, and exposing the behavior of enforcement obligors who evade, circumvent, or resist enforcement. Great importance shall be attached to public opinion communication. Through various forms such as entering villages, communities, and enterprises, extensively and deeply understand the opinions and suggestions of the people and all sectors of society on enforcement work, transform reasonable public opinions into specific measures to improve work, and enhance the level of enforcement work.

II. Accelerating the Construction of a Long-Term Mechanism for Enforcement Work

(1) Establish a joint meeting system for enforcement work. People's Courts at all levels shall, under the leadership of Party committees at all levels, fully leverage the role of the joint meeting system for enforcement work, organize the investigation and clearance of local regulations and documents that hinder enforcement, solve outstanding difficulties encountered in enforcement work and problems that the courts themselves cannot solve, supervise and investigate illegal or disciplinary acts of Party and government departments or leading cadres who illegally intervene in enforcement or special subjects who obstruct or resist enforcement, coordinate the handling of major emergencies or violent resistance incidents that may affect social stability, and major enforcement complaint cases; organize campaigns to centrally clear backlogged enforcement cases, and implement listed supervision over various key enforcement cases; for cases involving special subjects such as government agencies and state-owned enterprises, study and propose solutions. Major enforcement matters, after discussion and decision by the joint meeting or formation of meeting minutes, shall be handed over to relevant departments for implementation, and the implementation status shall be included in the scope of comprehensive governance assessment.

(2) Accelerate the construction of a linkage and deterrence mechanism for enforcement. People's Courts at all levels shall strive for the support of Party committees, mobilizing the strength of the entire society to jointly solve the difficulty in enforcement. Institutionally clarify the specific responsibilities of Party and government management departments related to enforcement work, including disciplinary inspection and supervision, organizational and personnel, news propaganda, comprehensive governance, procuratorial, public security, government legal affairs, finance, civil affairs, development and reform, judicial administration, land and resources management, housing and urban-rural construction management, People's Bank, banking supervision, taxation, industry and commerce administration, and securities supervision, in actively assisting People's Courts in carrying out relevant work. Build a nationwide court enforcement case information management system, actively participate in the construction of a social credit system, achieve the sharing of enforcement case information with credit information from other departments, and use credit punishment measures to prompt debtors to voluntarily fulfill obligations.

(3) Implement a strict evaluation mechanism for enforcement work. Improve and refine the existing enforcement work assessment system, scientifically set indicators such as the rate of enforcement标的 (subject matter) actually realized, the rate of enforcement complaints, the rate of enforcement case closure, the rate of qualified enforcement case closure, and the rate of voluntary performance, reasonably allocate assessment scores, and establish a standardized and effective assessment and evaluation mechanism. Assessments shall be conducted regularly and uniformly by People's Courts at all levels within their jurisdiction. The results of assessments shall be publicly ranked, and a system for analyzing the last-place situation, a reporting system, and an accountability system shall be established. Implement a system for quality evaluation of enforcement cases and analysis of time overruns, and include the quality and efficiency of enforcement cases within the supervision scope of the quality and efficiency management department. People's Courts at all levels shall establish an evaluation mechanism for enforcement personnel, establish quality and efficiency files, and use them as an important basis for assessment and rating, promotion and rank advancement, and evaluation and commendation. Establish scientific case closure standards, establish a strict system for procedural closure of cases without property, and make closure statistics. Establish a system for analysis and reverse investigation of responsibility for erroneous and defective enforcement cases by the Enforcement Bureau of the higher court and the quality and efficiency management department of the same court. When a higher court revokes or changes a ruling or decision of a lower court, it shall also conduct a responsibility analysis of the case. When the quality and efficiency management department of the same court discovers problems in an enforcement case, it shall also conduct a responsibility analysis.

III. Continuing to Advance Enforcement Reform

(1) Optimize the allocation of enforcement powers and responsibilities. First, further improve the enforcement work management mechanism of higher People's Courts for unified management and unified coordination of enforcement work. Intermediate People's Courts (excluding municipalities directly under the Central Government) shall implement unified management and unified coordination of enforcement work within their jurisdiction. Further promote the management model that combines "management of cases, management of affairs, and management of personnel." Second, shift the focus of enforcement of cases downward. The Supreme People's Court and Higher People's Courts, as institutions for unified management and unified coordination of enforcement work, shall in principle not enforce specific cases. Cases shall be mainly enforced by Intermediate and Basic People's Courts, or specific cases may be assigned to specialized courts for enforcement to exclude improper interference. Third, scientifically define enforcement review power and enforcement implementation power, and have them exercised by different internal institutions or personnel. Matters such as property investigation, control, disposition, delivery and distribution, and the adoption of coercive measures such as fines and detention shall be handled by the implementation agency; matters such as various enforcement objections, reconsiderations, objections by third parties, and applications for changing the enforcing court shall be handled by the review agency. Fourth, implement a scientific process management for enforcement cases, break the traditional enforcement model where one person is responsible from beginning to end, and actively explore the establishment of a segmented and intensive enforcement work mechanism. Designate specific personnel to be responsible for the unified investigation, control, and disposition of the debtor's property to improve enforcement efficiency. Implement a process management system characterized by node control, and fully leverage the role of the collegial panel and the joint meeting of the presiding judge (execution chief) in reviewing, evaluating, and proposing enforcement plans.

(2) Unify the structure of enforcement institutions. People's Courts at all levels shall uniformly establish an Enforcement Bureau, and unify the internal institutions and functions of the Enforcement Bureau. Higher People's Courts shall establish institutions for reconsideration supervision, coordination and guidance, complaint review, and comprehensive management. Intermediate and Basic People's Courts shall establish institutions for enforcement implementation, enforcement review, complaint review, and comprehensive management. The reconsideration supervision institution shall be responsible for the supervision of enforcement cases, and handle cases of objection reconsideration, applications for changing the enforcing court, and enforcement supervision cases; the coordination and guidance institution shall be responsible for the coordination and management of cross-jurisdictional entrusted enforcement cases and enforcement cases in other locations, handle enforcement consultation cases, and coordinate with relevant departments of the same level of government; the complaint review institution shall be responsible for the review and supervision of enforcement complaint and petition cases; the comprehensive management institution shall be responsible for various comprehensive matters such as management deployment, inspection and supervision, evaluation and assessment, drafting normative documents, and research and statistics of enforcement work within the jurisdiction.

(3) Reasonably determine the division of responsibilities between enforcement institutions and other departments. Clarify the division of responsibilities between the enforcement institution and other relevant departments of the court, and promote the professionalization of enforcement work and the professionalization of the enforcement team. Implement strict centralized management, clarifying that the enforcement of non-litigation administrative cases and administrative litigation cases, property preservation, advance execution, and property penalties shall be uniformly implemented by the enforcement institution. Strengthen and regulate the participation of judicial police in enforcement work. The trial supervision division of Basic People's Courts and the quality and efficiency management departments of Higher and Intermediate People's Courts shall undertake functions such as quality supervision of enforcement work and responsibility analysis of defective cases.

IV. Strengthening the Supervision and Restriction Mechanism for Enforcement

People's Courts at all levels shall regard strengthening the supervision and restriction mechanism for enforcement as an important part of the long-term mechanism construction, and earnestly grasp and implement it. First, scientifically allocate enforcement powers in accordance with the principle of separation of powers and checks and balances. Distinguish between enforcement review power and enforcement implementation power, and have them exercised by different internal institutions or personnel, so that various powers and functions mutually restrict and supervise each other, ensuring the proper exercise of enforcement powers. Second, conduct risk prevention for key links and critical nodes of enforcement implementation. Except for areas with very small staffing, enforcement implementation power shall be further decomposed, key links and critical nodes shall be summarized, divided into several stages, and assigned to different organizations or personnel, strengthening mutual supervision and restriction, thereby enhancing dynamic management of enforcement work and preventing abuse of enforcement power. Third, increase the intensity of supervision of higher courts over lower courts. Conscientiously implement and strictly enforce the amended Civil Procedure Law, correct illegal enforcement and passive enforcement behaviors, and strengthen supervision over the exercise of enforcement power through handling enforcement objections, enforcement reconsiderations, and third-party objection cases, as well as through higher courts upgrading enforcement, designating enforcement, and cross enforcement. Fourth, further implement enforcement openness, and consciously accept supervision from all parties involved in enforcement. Establish systems such as issuing a clean government supervision card or enforcement supervision card at the stage of enforcement case filing, publishing or informing the hotline number when serving enforcement documents, and allowing parties to legitimately participate in enforcement. Implement the enforcement openness system, use information technology and the internet to enhance the transparency of enforcement work, strictly prohibit behind-the-scenes operations, and effectively protect the parties' rights to know, participate, and supervise, preventing problems such as bending the law for personal gain, power-for-money deals, and illegal interference in handling cases, ensuring enforcement fairness. Fifth, broaden supervision channels and actively accept supervision from all sectors of society over enforcement work. Improve various supervision mechanisms such as those of Party committees, People's Congresses, and public opinion, explore methods and channels for people's jurors and enforcement supervisors to participate in enforcement work, and enhance the credibility of enforcement.

V. Further Strengthening the Construction of the Enforcement Team

People's Courts at all levels shall attach great importance to the construction of the enforcement team. Strengthen training for the heads of enforcement bureaus and enforcement personnel of People's Courts at all levels, and carry out regular exchanges between enforcement personnel and trial personnel of various business departments. Emphasize the construction of a clean and honest enforcement team, gradually equip enforcement institutions with clean government supervisors, and increase supervision over key links prone to corruption in enforcement; strengthen professional ethics education, power concept education, and warning education for enforcement personnel; regulate the interactions between enforcement personnel and parties and lawyers, refine job responsibilities, strengthen work management measures, and mitigate clean government risks; establish smooth channels for reporting, informing, and accusing, and a strong mechanism for investigating and correcting illegal and disciplinary acts, ensuring that the "five prohibitions" are fully implemented in enforcement work. According to the actual needs of enforcement work, fully equip and strengthen enforcement personnel, ensuring that the proportion of enforcement personnel meets the requirement of not less than 15% of the total existing staff establishment as stipulated in Document Zhongfa [1999] No. 11, and ensuring that the educational level of enforcement personnel is not lower than the average level of the court's personnel. Promptly formulate and issue the "Regulations on Enforcement Officers of the People's Courts," specifying the qualifications for appointment, appointment and removal procedures, job responsibilities, assessment and training, and other content, and strive to build a fair, efficient, clean, and civilized enforcement team.
